description: Browse the eBid.net marketplace category tree (eBid Trading API GetCategoryList): category IDs, names, full paths and per-category item counts for an eBid country site. Pass a parent category_id to list its subcategories, or omit it for the root categories. Use the returned CategoryID to filter ebid_search.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

category_id.description: Parent CategoryID to list children of. Omit for root categories.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

name: ebid_categories
title: Ebid Categories
